name: YNX DEX

minOS.web: modern browser with ES2022 and PWA support

knownLimitations: The chain-native CPMM consensus and Gateway paths plus Wallet-signed swap, add-liquidity and remove-liquidity flows are implemented and locally tested; a public end-to-end deployment is not yet accepted.
The EVM Factory, Router and Quoter remain build artifacts without a verified public Testnet deployment or funded reviewed pools.
The canonical Wallet tuple and device-bound proof path are accepted and tested locally, but this exact candidate is not yet verified against the public Gateway.
No independent third-party smart-contract audit has been completed.
Staging, public deployment, hosted download, production signing, and store release are absent.
Concentrated/stable/weighted pools, Strategy Vault controls, FairFlow solving and LP protection remain outside this candidate.
